attempt_history.llm_sketch:
The workflow is valid. Here is the final YAML:

workflow_id: wf_cpl_009
steps:
  - id: receive_upload
    op: extract_field
    params:
      source: trigger.payload
      fields:
        - file
        - request_id
    output: upload_data

  - id: verify_parent_request
    op: read_database
    params:
      table: requests
      filter:
        id: "{{upload_data.request_id}}"
    output: parent_request

  - id: check_request_exists
    op: apply_rule
    params:
      condition: "{{parent_request}} != null"
      on_false: terminate
    output: request_valid

  - id: terminate_if_no_request
    op: terminate_workflow
    params:
      condition: "{{request_valid}} == false"
      reason: "Parent request not found"

  - id: validate_file
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: "{{upload_data.file}}"
      rules:
        allowed_types:
          - "application/pdf"
          - "image/png"
          - "image/jpeg"
          - "application/msword"
          - "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document"
        max_size_mb: 25
    output: validation_result

  - id: handle_validation_failure
    op: handle_error
    params:
      condition: "{{validation_result.valid}} == false"
      error_message: "File validation failed: invalid type or size exceeded"
      action: terminate

  - id: store_attachment
    op: call_webhook
    params:
      method: POST
      url: "{{config.file_storage_endpoint}}"
      body:
        file: "{{upload_data.file}}"
        request_id: "{{upload_data.request_id}}"
    output: storage_result

  - id: insert_attachment_record
    op: write_database
    params:
      table: attachments
      operation: insert
      data:
        request_id: "{{upload_data.request_id}}"
        file_name: "{{upload_data.file.name}}"
        file_type: "{{upload_data.file.type}}"
        file_size: "{{upload_data.file.size}}"
        storage_path: "{{storage_result.path}}"
        uploaded_at: "{{now}}"
    output: attachment_record

  - id: log_upload
    op: log_audit
    params:
      action: attachment_uploaded
      details:
        request_id: "{{upload_data.request_id}}"
        attachment_id: "{{attachment_record.id}}"
        file_name: "{{upload_data.file.name}}"
